newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bids for Portugal mobile phone licence June - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bids for Portugal mobile phone licence June - paper.

text.p: The Portuguese government will open bidding in June for a third mobile phone operator, a senior government official was quoted as saying.

"The specification of the bidding is practically concluded and will be presented by the Portugal Communications Institute in June," Under-Secretary for Telecommunications Leonor Coutinho told Diario Economico newspaper.
The launch of bidding in June will permit the new operator to be chosen by the end of the year, the paper said.
The two mobile phone operators presently active in Portugal are Telecel and TMN, a unit of Portugal Telecom.
